items.title: Local Terrorists Wiped Out, Hunt On For 35 Pak Terrorists In Kashmir

items.title: Why is November 26 celebrated as Constitution Day in India
points: Jawaharlal Nehru signs India's Constitution at the final session of the Constituent Assembly on January 24.

The Constitution came into force on January 26, 1950, two months later, making India a republic.
However, November 26 is celebrated as the Constitution Day to commemorate the moment the Constitution of India was formally adopted for “We, the People of India”.
But the event ‘Constitution Day’ was started only a little over a decade ago when Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced it in October 2015 while laying the foundation stone for the Dr. B.R.

items.title: Constitution must have resonance far beyond precincts of Parliament, courts, writes PM Modi
